name: Homeward Compass

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Remembers a place and points back to it.
text: As a Magic action while holding this compass you can set where you stand as its destination; it then points that way while you're on the same plane, and spins otherwise. Another Magic action clears it.

params.text: fixes its needle on this place
